name: dynamite-alerts-mobs
description: D-149 (user 2026-11-21 12:25; all three mobs Greydwarfs - one faction, so they do not fight each other first): lighting the fuse alerts mobs a little (like a pickaxe hit, 15 m), the blast alerts many (60 m) and they go towards it; a mob 90 m away does not react. The player is in ghost mode while the fuse is lit (so the fuse check is about the noise); ghost and fly mode go off before the blast (T-030).

steps.name: GunPowdered.setSkill
steps.label: Explosives skill 50: the 4 s fuse these timings were written for (D-157)

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseLast
steps.regex: dynamite fuse lit at .*radius 15 m, alerted [1-9]
steps.label: the lit fuse alerts the Greydwarf 10 m from it (like a pickaxe hit)

steps.name: GunPowdered.playerPlain
steps.label: ghost and fly mode off before the blast (user 2026-11-23 03:20): the Brute must not be left with a target it cannot see or reach

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseLast
steps.label: the blast alerts mobs within 60 m

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseCreatureCloser
steps.label: remember where the Brute stands when the blast is marked

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseCreature
steps.regex: target Human, last known [0-1]\.\d m from the blast
steps.label: the Greydwarf Brute 39 m from the blast hunts the player and knows where the blast was (the game clears its alerted flag again while it cannot see the player)

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseCreature
steps.label: the Greydwarf Shaman 90 m away did not hear it

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseCreatureCloser
steps.label: the Brute heads for the blast: at least 5 m closer within 12 s than where it stood when the blast went off (a18g16-1: a fixed 33 m mark failed when it started further out)
